about_the_game:
Dirty Street Food Simulator

🍜 Dirty Street Food Simulator is a street food simulation game set in a large, open city. You start with a basic food cart and simple recipes, cooking and selling meals to customers on the streets. As you earn money, you can move your stall to busier and more expensive areas, unlock advanced recipes, and improve your equipment.

🕒 Delivering food on time and exactly as requested is essential. The faster and more accurate you are, the more tips you receive — and positive customer reviews. These reviews affect your reputation and can unlock new opportunities as your business grows.

🛠️ Features:

  • 🏙️ Large city map with multiple districts to explore and expand into

  • 🍲 Cooking and recipe system – learn new meals, prepare them properly, and serve them hot

  • 💵 Economy and progression – upgrade your gear, unlock premium locations, and manage your income

  • 🛒 Interact with city systems – visit the bank, second-hand stores, suppliers, and more

  • ⭐ Customer satisfaction system – tips and reviews directly impact your success

This game is all about building your street food business from the ground up. No gimmicks, no shortcuts — just cooking, serving, and surviving in a busy urban environment.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GT 1050 / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: NO
  • Additional Notes: Ray tracing features such as shadows, reflections, and ambient lighting are optional and require an NVIDIA RTX 2000 series or newer graphics card to be enabled. Additionally, DLSS is supported for improved performance on compatible NVIDIA GPUs. Upscaling technologies like AMD FSR can also be used with all supported graphics cards, including AMD RX 400 series and newer, as well as NVIDIA GTX 900 series and newer.

short_description: A street food simulation game where you cook and sell meals in a dynamic city. Start small, unlock new recipes, upgrade your setup, and move into wealthier districts. Serve orders quickly and correctly to earn tips, gain positive reviews, and grow your street food empire.
